mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >55% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt accommodative policies, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235.0.
